t: No vector file of its own
say: No vector file cites or names these laws. Each is pinned by its proof alone, or by a whole family of vectors, as protocol/laws.md says in its own words.
A single vector pins each of these laws. That is one input and one answer: the law is pinned at one point.
These laws have vectors, and JavaScript runs none of them. All of them are tick vectors, which JavaScript does not run (W3). The model and Rust run every one.

protocol/laws.md cites a set of vectors for each law, and each vector names the laws it pins. For these laws the two lists differ. − counts files cited that don't name the law; + counts files naming it that aren't cited.
No theorem names these laws. They hold because of how the code is built, and their vectors pin them.
